notablePrerequisites:
Freed from the Real attached to Circle of Dreams Druid.
Circle of Dreams Druid does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one other creature.
description:
Activate Circle of Dreams Druid by tapping it to add at least {G}{G}.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {G} to untap Circle of Dreams Druid.
Repeat.
